projects.name: Standard Chartered Bank, Nationwide Building Society and
details: Eradah Capital
• Working closely with the Business PO to understand the business requirements
which pertain to International Payments.
• Communicating with stakeholders and other departments to provide solutions for
the product requirements, to solve the existing issues in BAU and to reduce the
manual work.
• Experienced in handling MX message migration in core Transaction Processing
system – ISO 20022.
• Experienced with Cross border SWIFT payments – Pacs.008, Pacs.009,
Pacs.009COV, MT103, MT202, MT202COV in India Telegraphic Transfer (TT).
• Responsible for creating user stories in Jira and Azure DevOps tools and
presenting to the squad.
• Closely working with scrum by following the Agile methodology, attending daily
scrum call to discuss the updates towards the requirement activity and resolve if
any issues.
• Having knowledge in API interfaces between core processing system and other
associated applications.
• Experienced at analyzing the current business model for performing Gap analysis
and generating ‘As – Is’ and ‘To – Be’ process flows.
• Having knowledge on Payments, Treasury and Reconciliation tool’s UAT testing.
• Having knowledge on Payments Screening application and the Fircosoft format.
